_comment: Depth-room deck. Four suits: a verb, a setting, a rule seed, and a growth engine (where later content comes from). No commas inside cards. Cards that echo the returning ideas (roll, junkyard, folded space) are left out on purpose so new pitches don't converge on them.
setting: a city made of one building
rule_seed: the world remembers what you did
every tool has a side effect
you can only affect things you can see
gravity points at the heaviest thing
time moves only when you move
you shape the level before you play it
the map is made of tiles you carry
growth_engine: a new rule per world that combines with the old ones
materials that combine into new materials
enemies or hazards that adapt to you
an upgrade tree that changes the verb itself
a world that changes between runs
a sandbox mode unlocked by the campaign
goals that chain into bigger goals
one persistent world you keep reshaping
